content.short: WITNESS Protocol develops novel L2 protocols to scale onchain utility.
content.description: WITNESS Protocol enables trustless on-chain timestamps without incurring on-chain transaction fees. By anchoring off-chain information—such as images, files, or attestations—to a broad set of public blockchains, it supports scalable anchoring across networks. The approach works for any data size and minimizes friction, delivering on-chain references without the costs normally associated with frequent transactions. This cross-chain capability provides verifiable records of existence and integrity for diverse datasets.
